code.cells: app.modules.analytics.cells (cell semantics shared by the xls + xlsx writers)

format.note: every format shares one validation path, one job payload shape and one worker entry point (generate_report_file). FORMAT_GENERATORS in report_service is the single source of truth: the router's SUPPORTED_FORMATS is derived from it, so an accepted format always has a generator. Each generator reads ONLY from ReportDatasetService.

filters.note: frozen P4-01-01 UnifiedFilter, same semantics as P1 list and dataset

columns.default: null = the 5 ТЗ columns in documented order (university, direction, product, workflow_status, responsible)
columns.order: output column order strictly follows the resolved request order (never sorted)

pdf.note: same filters/columns as xlsx; PDF renders title/period/filters/timestamp/KPI/table/charts (see report-output.json)

json.note: columns=null selects the 5 ТЗ default columns; export shape is {metadata, filters, columns, rows, totals} (see report-output.json)

xls.note: legacy Excel BIFF8 workbook, same sheets/rows as xlsx (Отчёт + Фильтры, header row 6, data from row 7). BIFF8 limits: 65536 rows x 256 columns; exceeding them fails the job with XlsCapacityError instead of truncating. BIFF8 has no autofilter and no freeze panes.

async_api.rbac: reports.read (401 without token, 403 without permission; held by admin + manager, never widened)
async_api.lifecycle: queued -> building -> ready | failed (progress: queued=0, building=10, ready=100; failed keeps current)
async_api.status_endpoint: GET /api/v1/reports/{job_id} -> 200 ReportJobRead (id/format/status/progress/file_size/created_at/started_at/completed_at/expires_at/error_message; never the filesystem path)
async_api.status_rbac: admin sees all jobs; other reports.read holders see only their own jobs (foreign -> 403, unknown/malformed -> 404)
async_api.download: GET /api/v1/reports/{job_id}/download -> 200 file only when ready + fresh + allowed; 409 when not ready/failed; 410 Gone when expires_at passed or the artifact is gone; Content-Disposition attachment report_<job_id>.<ext> with xls/xlsx/pdf/json media types
async_api.expiry: expires_at = created_at + 24h (tz-aware); cleanup_expired_report_jobs() removes expired artifacts (daily cron/CLI entry run_cleanup_once; no Celery)
async_api.security_snapshot: job stores actor_sub/actor_roles/effective_university_ids at creation; the worker rehydrates ONLY this snapshot (scoped user asking for foreign universities gets zero rows; empty scope fails closed)
async_api.storage: REPORTS_ROOT (default /app/reports, REPORTS_DIR honored as legacy alias) via <final>.part + atomic replace; filenames server-generated report_<job_id>.<ext>; stored paths containment-checked on download
async_api.status: LIVE since P4-06-01: persistent report_jobs storage (migration 000018) + BackgroundTasks worker; the router is mounted and POST returns a real persisted job_id

report_sheet_rows.1: title: Аналитический отчёт по взаимодействию с ВУЗами
report_sheet_rows.2: period (neutral 'Период: не задан' when both bounds absent)
report_sheet_rows.3: human-readable filter summary (raw values stay on sheet 2)
report_sheet_rows.7+: data rows in resolved column order

xlsx_workbook.auto_filter: A6:<last_column>6 (header row only; resolves the A7:X7 source contradiction)
xlsx_workbook.dates: typed date/datetime cells with DD.MM.YYYY number format
xlsx_workbook.formula_injection: leading =,+,-,@ in text escaped with apostrophe; numerics untouched
xlsx_workbook.storage: REPORTS_ROOT (default /app/reports, REPORTS_DIR honored as legacy alias) via <final>.part + atomic replace

pdf_document.note: title/period/filters/timestamp/KPI/table/charts; landscape A4; DejaVu Sans (OS package fonts-dejavu-core)

json_export.note: {generated_at, filters, columns, total, items}; typed serialization; streaming writer

xls_workbook.note: same metadata block, sheet names, header row and cell semantics as xlsx_workbook

limits.on_overflow: XlsCapacityError -> job failed with a readable message; the file is never truncated

unsupported_vs_xlsx: autofilter (BIFF8 has no record for it)
